title: Introduction to Python Programming
content: Python is a popular programming language used for automation, scripting, data analysis, and web development. Beginners appreciate its readable syntax.

title: Data Science Fundamentals
content: Data science combines statistics, programming, and domain knowledge to extract useful insights from data using analysis and visualization.

title: Machine Learning Basics
content: Machine learning enables computer systems to learn patterns from data. Common methods include supervised learning, classification, and regression.

title: Database Management Systems
content: A database management system stores, organizes, retrieves, and protects structured information. SQL is widely used to query relational databases.

title: Java Enterprise Development
content: Java is an object-oriented programming language used to build enterprise applications, backend services, and platform-independent software.

title: Web Development with Python
content: Python web frameworks help developers build websites, APIs, and web applications. Web development includes frontend and backend engineering.

title: Artificial Intelligence Overview
content: Artificial intelligence studies systems that perform tasks associated with human intelligence, including reasoning, language processing, and learning.

title: Big Data Technologies
content: Big data platforms process large datasets with distributed storage and computing. Data engineering prepares reliable data pipelines for analytics.

title: Information Retrieval Models
content: Information retrieval finds relevant documents from collections. Boolean retrieval represents each term as a set of document identifiers and combines sets with AND OR and NOT.

title: Operating System Concepts
content: An operating system manages computer hardware, memory, processes, files, and application execution.
